about: Labelled turns for the session recap (Phase 6). Each is one request to Claude Code: the steps it took and its final message. label: how the turn ended (done, partial, needs-input, failed; rubric in RECAP_SYSTEM). mentions: facts the recap should state, each a list of ways to say it. avoid: claims the title or summary must not make. Paths are made up (C:\work\<project>).

cases.lastMessage: Fixed the rounding: totals now round once at the end instead of on every line, which caused the 1-cent drift. I also updated the test that expected the old behaviour. All 112 tests pass.
cases.note: The first test run failed, the last passed: the last run counts.

cases.label: done
cases.prompt: How does the hook server check the token?
cases.lastMessage: It compares the Authorization header with `Bearer <token>` using crypto.timingSafeEqual, after checking the lengths match, so the token can't be guessed byte by byte. Requests without it get a 401.
cases.note: A question answered with no changes: the recap must not claim edits.
